title: feat: Apps and Quests as Source values
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Source now has exactly one value per item: Apps, then Quests, then Agent / Team / Community
- Apps: issues with `APP-SUBMISSION` and PRs that close one; Quests: issues with `POLLEN-QUEST` and PRs that close one
- When one of those labels is added after an issue is opened, the workflow reruns and updates only the Source (no AI call)
- The Dev Source field already has the Apps and Quests options

The Express job keeps applying to Community issues only.

gist.headline: A place for every seed
gist.blurb: App submissions and Pollen Quests get their own Source values on the project board. Add a label later, and the workflow quietly fixes the filing.
gist.summary: The GitHub project organizer assigns exactly one Source per issue or PR, prioritizing Apps for APP-SUBMISSION, then Quests for POLLEN-QUEST, then Agent, Team, or Community; adding either label later updates Source without an AI call.
gist.impact: App submissions and Pollen Quests, including PRs that close them, are filed under their own Source values, while the Express job remains limited to Community issues.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy GitHub-style project board with distinct Apps, Quests, and Community trays. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, sorts a flower-shaped app card and a quest scroll into their trays; a small code-plant grows beside the board.
